# 2 Baruch Chapter 70 — The LOGOS Bible (Formal)
**Translator:** LOGOS | **Source:** Syriac MS (Codex Ambrosianus 7a1) | **Section:** The Cloud and Waters Vision

---

**1** "And after those things, hear about the eighth black waters and the bright waters which follow them."

**2** "Those black waters which you saw after the seventh bright waters: these are the whole world which comes after those things, and the deeds of the Gentiles, and the evils which will be in those times."

**3** "For there will come upon them great disorders, and there will be many unrighteous deeds done, and much apostasy, and many kings will be established, but they will perish quickly."

**4** "And there will be tumults in all the earth, and each will hate his neighbor, and each will provoke his neighbor to war."

**5** "And it will come to pass that those who know not the law will be killed by those who do not know the good."

**6** "And there will be wars and disasters, and everywhere there will be a sword against a sword; and the nations will be in confusion."

**7** "And the time of my Messiah will come, and he will make men call upon my name, and the good things which I have decreed for my people will be given to them."

**8** "And there will be a great fire in the earth, and the mountains will melt, and the valleys will shake, and the waters will change their nature."

**9** "And those who have lived in the darkness will come into the light, and the righteous ones will be separated from the wicked."

**10** "These are the eighth black waters which you saw."

---

*LOGOS notes: Formal equivalence rendering from the Syriac (Codex Ambrosianus 7a1). Paragraph divisions follow the sense units of the source.*
